title: Four apps, four parts of the board
subject: Mathematics
objective: Read a number in the millions from each part of a divided board.

steps.heading: Four apps
steps.text: Four apps, and how many people use each one.
I will divide the board into four parts. Top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right.

objects.name: WhatsApp
explain: Two billion. A two, then nine zeros. Three commas.

objects.name: TikTok
explain: One billion, six hundred million. Still ten digits.

steps.text: TikTok. One billion, six hundred million.

objects.name: Snapchat
explain: Eight hundred and fifty million. Nine digits, so no billion group.

steps.text: Snapchat. Eight hundred and fifty million.

objects.name: Telegram

explain.say: Nine hundred and fifty million. Split it at the commas.

explain: Two commas, so millions. Nine hundred and fifty of them.

steps.text: And Telegram. Nine hundred and fifty million.
WhatsApp. TikTok. Snapchat. Telegram. Tap any of them and it will come forward.
Let me bring Snapchat forward. The others step back.
Split it at the commas. Eight hundred and fifty, then two groups of zeros.
Two commas means millions. Eight hundred and fifty million.

ask.prompt: Tap the app with the fewest users.
ask.hint: Look for the smallest first group before the commas.

ask.prompt: How many zeros are in one million?
ask.hint: Two commas, three zeros after each.

steps.text: That is reading millions. Count the commas first.
